description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wilakatupotha, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420953
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of particular land parcels (Parcel No. 54 and 58) with detailed property descriptions, owner identities, and legal status. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
